reason: This PR changes runtime transaction-limit behavior from static config to system-variable control, touching `session`/`sessionctx` sysvar plumbing, `kv` transaction options, the txn driver, and `planner` SET handling, with extra DDL call-site changes and real TiKV txn tests. That is central session/transaction correctness surface with non-trivial blast radius: limit enforcement, session/global scoping, option propagation, and DDL/background transaction behavior can all regress in high-impact ways.
